title: Packet reorder buffer
description: Implement reorder(packets, start=0). packets is a list of (seq, payload) pairs arriving in any order. Return (delivered, pending) where delivered is the payloads for seq start, start+1, ... up to the first gap, in order, and pending is the sorted list of buffered seq numbers that could not be delivered yet.
invariants: Duplicate seq numbers: the first payload seen wins.
Packets with seq < start are dropped.
A gap stops delivery; later packets stay in pending.
